one_liner: A collaborative document workspace platform with a RESTful API for programmatically interacting with docs, pages, tables, and rows.
access_notes: API access is available for free across both free and paid workspaces, and API tokens can be generated directly from account settings.
verdict_reason: Coda offers a fully self-serve public REST API accessible with bearer tokens generated directly from user account settings, accompanied by an official OpenAPI spec.

evidence.snippet: It accepts HTTP bearer tokens (UUID) (Bearer). By default, every request must be authenticated.
We make the Superhuman Docs API available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces.
